hooks.command: [ -f "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}/.sdlc.toml" ] || exit 0; P="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/hook.py"; export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"; if ! command -v uv >/dev/null 2>&1; then printf '%s\n' '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"SessionStart","additionalContext":"sdlc: uv is not installed; the /sdlc commands need it. Ask the user before installing it (https://docs.astral.sh/uv/getting-started/installation/)."}}'; exit 0; fi; exec uv run --no-project "$P" session-start
[ -f "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}/.sdlc.toml" ] || exit 0; P="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/hook.py"; export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"; exec uv run --no-project "$P" pre-edit

[ -f "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}/.sdlc.toml" ] || exit 0; I=$(cat); T="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}/.sdlc.toml"; if ! printf '%s' "$I" | grep -qi deploy && ! grep -E "command[[:space:]]*=" "$T" | grep -Evq "command[[:space:]]*=[[:space:]]*(\"\"|'')[[:space:]]*(#.*)?\$"; then exit 0; fi; P="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/hook.py"; export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"; printf '%s' "$I" | exec uv run --no-project "$P" pre-bash
[ -f "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}/.sdlc.toml" ] || exit 0; P="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/hook.py"; export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"; exec uv run --no-project "$P" post-edit

[ -f "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}/.sdlc.toml" ] || exit 0; I=$(cat); case "$I" in *commit*) ;; *) exit 0 ;; esac; P="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/hook.py"; export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"; printf '%s' "$I" | exec uv run --no-project "$P" post-bash
